Office catering / presentation outline

Fictional example, prepared to show the format of a deliverable. No client work, research, message sending or automation was performed by opening this page.

Fictional business: Cedar Kitchen. Audience: local office administrators. Purpose: introduce an office catering service for discussion.

1 / The offer

Simple lunch packages for small office gatherings. The final menu, serving sizes, delivery area and prices must be supplied and approved by the business.

Suggested slide: one clear headline, an approved food photograph, the audience and the next action.

2 / How an enquiry works

  1. The customer shares the date, location, headcount and dietary needs.
  2. The business confirms availability, menu and a written quote.
  3. The customer approves the order under the business’s agreed payment terms.

Speaker note: explain the process without promising availability or delivery times that have not been confirmed.

3 / Before this becomes a PDF

  • Approve the business name, logo and contact details.
  • Insert the real menu, images and prices.
  • Confirm dietary wording, delivery area and enquiry link.
  • Review the final layout and requested deadline.

Example call to action: “Tell us about your next team lunch.”
